name: KleinClaw
description: Kleinanzeigen tools that can change live listings, edit local browser settings, and run the embedded miniclaw browser runtime with redacted output.

workingDirectory.description: Directory where miniclaw should find config.yaml when no config path is set.

configPath.description: Optional path to the miniclaw config. Tool output redacts this path.

adRoots.description: Trusted roots for adConfigPaths and adDirectories scoped operations.

workspaceMode.description: miniclaw workspace mode. Defaults to portable.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum runtime for one local miniclaw command (status, verify, reads).

liveTimeoutMs.description: Maximum runtime for one live browser run (publish, update, delete, download, extend, sync check). Defaults to 600000.

maxOutputChars.description: Maximum sanitized stdout or stderr characters returned by the tool.

approvalMode.description: Approval mode for tool runs. Use all for every tool, mutating for side-effect tools only, or none to rely on tool-level confirm gates.

paymentDetails.description: Your own bank details for buyers who pay by transfer. kleinanzeigen_send_message inserts them for {bankverbindung} when includePaymentDetails is true; no other account numbers are ever sent.
